crossRefs.note: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be…
You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”
translations.bsb: Then Jesus straightened up and asked her, “Woman, where are your accusers? Has no one condemned you?”
translations.kjv: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
translations.asv: And Jesus lifted up himself, and said unto her, Woman, where are they? did no man condemn thee?
